intro.text: A darkeyed Alethi huntmaster and longtime associate of Dalinar Kholin.
A darkeyed Alethi and longtime friend of Dalinar Kholin who has been his huntmaster and now leads his scouts.

items.text: On the night Adolin was born, Bashin went with Dalinar and Havar to a wrestling hall in Kholinar. Dalinar liked that they treated him as a friend rather than a highprince, and drank heavily and used firemoss in their company. Bashin nervously bet his hat on a match, and won.

When Dalinar tried to stand in for a sick wrestler, his opponent was plainly terrified, and Bashin and Havar had to tell Dalinar he had maimed three men in a tavern brawl weeks earlier. When Toh came with news that Evi had gone into labor, Bashin tried to hide Dalinar's firemoss.
Bashin was at a meeting with the Parshendi during King Gavilar's reign.

On the Shattered Plains, Bashin was huntmaster for a chasmfiend hunt with Dalinar, Adolin, Renarin and Sadeas. His team tracked the beast, prepared a plateau with a hog carcass as bait and set up a pavilion for spectators on a separate plateau. He advised the nobles to aim grandbows at its legs, and was hopeful, as the beast was huge.
The chasmfiend came early and struck the viewing plateau instead, eating a chull and injuring several people before the Shardbearers responded and Elhokar killed it.

Bashin joined Dalinar's push into the Shattered Plains, coordinating scouts and reporting Parshendi sightings. His scouts killed a Parshendi in a form never seen before, and he showed Dalinar and Shallan the body, puzzled by burn marks on dead scouts.
At Urithiru, Bashin looked after the Kholin axehound kennels, though the hounds were no longer used for hunting. In time he retired and gave his beloved floppy hat to Felt.

appearance.text: Short and portly, with a large belly. He wears rugged clothes like soldier's trousers and a leather overcoat, and a wide-brimmed, floppy brown hat from near the Purelake that he wears for decades despite the teasing.

personality.text: Cheerful and self-deprecating, Bashin gives plain, no-nonsense information. He doesn't fit the usual idea of a darkeyes: he has travelled widely and wants to see more, skips the uniform and sometimes calls Dalinar by his first name.
Well travelled and knowledgeable about chasmfiends, he is trusted with important tasks and respected among Dalinar's soldiers despite having no obvious rank.
